result.analyst_notes: Mostly factual, company-centric description with first-person plural voice. Scale and market-position claims dominate. Commitments are hedged with 'committed to' phrasing. The SPIRIT Values section is a heading with a generic definition and no named values. Employees, customers, safety and environment are not addressed. Social-feed posts and photo captions are site chrome.
